meta.collection_method: Tavily-first weekly refresh, with conservative official-source screening and duplicate suppression.
meta.notes: This file stores the candidate pool reviewed during the 2026-07-25 refresh. Only the L.E.K. item was net-new enough to merge into the formal leaderboard. The rest were either too weak, already captured, or too old for the current weekly window.

items.title: PwC 发布 The intelligent enterprise in action: AI and the next era of customer experience
items.summary: PwC 于 2026-07-22 发布 webcast，系统阐述如何把 AI 嵌入决策机制、客户体验与 enterprise-wide performance。
items.why_it_matters: 它把 customer experience、decision orchestration 和 enterprise design 连在一起，比一般市场观点更接近咨询公司的方法论资产。
items.merge_rationale: Net-new official webcast within the weekly window; merged into the formal leaderboard.

items.title: Capgemini 发布 Agentic AI in Sales and Operations Planning
items.summary: Capgemini 于 2026-07-23 发布 S&OP agentic AI 观点文章，讨论消费品牌如何借助 AI-powered adaptive planning 改善服务、降低成本并提升 forecast accuracy。
items.why_it_matters: 这条不是泛泛的 AI 叙事，而是比较清晰的行业场景与解决方案信号，还点出了其 S&OP Intelligence Co-Pilot。
items.merge_rationale: Net-new official industry use-case content within the weekly window; merged into the formal leaderboard.

items.title: FTI 发布 The New Shelf Space: How AI Agents Are Rewiring Brand Discovery
items.summary: FTI 于 2026-07-22 发布消费者与品牌研究，讨论 AI-driven commerce、LLM shelf share 与 agentic replenishment 如何改写品牌发现与购买决策链条。
items.why_it_matters: 这条很适合 FTI，因为它连接了 consumer、go-to-market 和 private equity 价值创造，并且给出了调查与数据支撑。
items.merge_rationale: Net-new official report within the weekly window; merged into the formal leaderboard.

items.title: Roland Berger AI hub 本周继续更新，Competing at the speed of learning 值得跟踪
items.summary: Roland Berger 的 Artificial Intelligence hub 在 2026 年 7 月持续更新，最新几篇可见日期包括 7 月 23 日、7 月 16 日、7 月 14 日、7 月 9 日和 7 月 6 日。
items.why_it_matters: 这说明 Roland Berger 的 AI 研究输出具有连续性，足以强化长期 thought leadership 底座；但在单篇标题和正文完全对齐前，正式周榜只按 hub 连续更新的中等强度信号入库。
items.merge_rationale: The AI hub's July update cadence is clear enough to strengthen Roland Berger's long-term thought-leadership base and support a medium-strength weekly continuity signal.

items.title: BCG 发布 CEO AI value survey：局部见效，但规模化仍然困难
items.summary: BCG 于 2026-07-22 发布官方研究，指出近九成 CEO 已在部分业务中看到 AI 带来的成本或收入改善，但大多数企业仍在规模化落地上挣扎。
items.why_it_matters: 这是很典型的 CEO 级 AI 执行差距研究，适合纳入 thought leadership 与战略判断维度。
items.merge_rationale: Net-new official research within the weekly window; merged into the formal leaderboard.

items.title: BCG 发布 Is AI Computing Power Becoming a Commodity?
items.summary: BCG 于 2026-07-23 发布 AI 计算资源专题文章，讨论算力市场正变得更透明、更可交易，并可能释放新的企业价值空间。
items.why_it_matters: 它比 7 月 22 日那条更偏专题 thought leadership，但仍然是时间明确、主题明确的 AI 公开内容。
items.merge_rationale: Net-new official AI article within the weekly window; merged into the formal leaderboard with a lower weight than the July 22 CEO survey item.

items.title: KPMG 与 OpenAI 建立战略联盟，推进 AI-native enterprise workflows
items.summary: KPMG 于 2026-07-21 官方宣布与 OpenAI 建立战略联盟，并被列为 OpenAI Partner Network 的 Elite Partner。
items.why_it_matters: 这是一条高质量官方合作信号，不仅是生态背书，还明确提到 workflow、SaaS modernization 和 forward deployed engineer 落地模式。
items.merge_rationale: Net-new official alliance within the weekly window; merged into the formal leaderboard.
